_provenance: Fictional demo data. Fuel prices, insurance figures, and depreciation curves are invented, round-number approximations for the Sift 'Choose Our Next Car' hackathon scenario and are not sourced from any real insurer, retailer, or market report.

sharedAssumptions.note: These assumptions are held constant across all four candidates so the resulting 5-year ownership estimates are comparable apples-to-apples. They are planning defaults for the ownership-cost calculator, separate from the actual per-candidate dealer financing offers recorded in dealer-offers.json.

fuel.priceSource: Fictional regional average, fixture-authored for internal consistency

insurance.coverageProfile: 100/300/100 liability, comprehensive and collision with $500 deductible
insurance.driverProfile: Two prime-tier adult drivers, no at-fault claims in the past 5 years, both with 15+ years licensed
insurance.note: Same coverage limits and driver profile priced against each candidate; the resulting annual premium still varies by vehicle risk class, listed per candidate below.

maintenance.note: Hybrid powertrains assumed slightly cheaper per mile due to regenerative braking reducing brake wear, offset elsewhere by hybrid battery inspection intervals.

depreciation.methodology: Straight-line against true out-the-door price using a fictional 5-year retained-value percentage by candidate.
depreciation.note: Retained-value percentages are fixture-authored planning estimates, not a real residual-value guide.

financingBaseline.note: Default assumption used only when modeling ownership cost independent of a specific dealer offer. Actual per-candidate APR/term from the accepted dealer offer takes precedence once one exists.
